text.en:
There is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated,
the sum of twenty thousand pesos to be used in the cementation, repair, and reconstruction of corrals, pier,
sheds, inclosures, and other buildings or structures at the Sisiman Matadero and Quarantine Station.

The money appropriated by this Act, shall be taken from and covered by the money collected as
slaughter fees from said Sisiman Matadero and Quarantine Station.

The Director of Agriculture is hereby authorized to undertake the work outlined in section one of
this Act, or may in his discretion cause the same to be undertaken, and to disburse the money appropriated

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 6, 1924.
